units: GM = c = 1; Schwarzschild radius Rs = 2M = 2; photon sphere at r = 1.5 Rs.
samplingFn: piecewise: i < N/2 → b = b_c * i / (N/2 - 1); i ≥ N/2 → b = b_c + (B_MAX - b_c) * (i - N/2) / (N - 1 - N/2)

channelLayout.r: totalDeflectionPhi (radians; π = no bend, > π = bent toward BH)
channelLayout.b: phiToPerihelion (radians; half of R for symmetric orbit)
channelLayout.a: captureFlag (1.0 = ray escapes, 0.0 = captured by BH)
